2026-06-03.quote: Before this storm, coverage was limited to elevations above 1900 m, mainly confined to isolated lee slopes and sheltered gullies.

2026-07-03.quote: Up to 22cm of dense storm total (elevation-dependent) sits on the ground.

2026-07-04.quote: The subalpine is below threshold with 20-30 cm of fairly low density snow.

2026-07-05.quote: However a widespread rime crust of 2-3cm exists on most aspects.
